scope: Local CSV files in full; optional existing warehouse, read-only.
caveats: Counts of distinct identifiers do not establish counts of business orders.
Source provenance, anonymization and identifier semantics are unverified.
Stored timestamps have no verified timezone; no timezone conversion applied.
Warehouse results describe the existing materialization, not a fresh build.

tiktok.load_sql: create temp table tiktok as select * from read_csv(?, all_varchar=true)

shopee.load_sql: create temp table shopee as select * from read_csv(?, all_varchar=true)

queries.sql:
select count(*) as rows, count(distinct order_id) as distinct_order_ids,
 count(distinct (user_id, shop_name, order_id)) as user_shop_order_keys,
 count(distinct pkId) as distinct_pk_ids, count(distinct shop_name) as shop_names,
 count(distinct user_id) as users,
 min(try_cast(created_time as timestamp)) as min_created,
 max(try_cast(created_time as timestamp)) as max_created,
 min(try_cast(updatedAt as timestamp)) as min_sync,
 max(try_cast(updatedAt as timestamp)) as max_sync,
 count(*) filter(where pkId is null) as null_pk,
 count(*) filter(where order_id is null) as null_order,
 count(*) filter(where created_time is not null and try_cast(created_time as timestamp) is null) as invalid_created,
 count(*) filter(where updatedAt is not null and try_cast(updatedAt as timestamp) is null) as invalid_sync,
 count(*) filter(where quantity is null or try_cast(quantity as integer) is null) as invalid_or_null_quantity,
 count(*) filter(where try_cast(quantity as integer)<=0) as nonpositive_quantity,
 count(*) filter(where regexp_matches(order_id, '(?i)e[+-][0-9]+')) as scientific_order_ids
from tiktok

select count(*) as affected_key_groups, coalesce(sum(n),0) as affected_rows
from (select pkId,count(*) as n from tiktok
      group by pkId having count(*)>1)

select count(*) as affected_key_groups, coalesce(sum(n),0) as affected_rows
from (select pkId,count(*) as n from tiktok
      group by pkId having count(distinct order_id)>1)

select count(*) as affected_key_groups, coalesce(sum(n),0) as affected_rows
from (select user_id,shop_name,pkId,count(*) as n from tiktok
      group by user_id,shop_name,pkId having count(distinct order_id)>1)

select count(*) as affected_key_groups, coalesce(sum(n),0) as affected_rows
from (select user_id,shop_name,order_id,count(*) as n from tiktok
      group by user_id,shop_name,order_id having count(distinct created_time)>1)

select count(*) as affected_key_groups, coalesce(sum(n),0) as affected_rows
from (select user_id,shop_name,order_id,count(*) as n from tiktok
      group by user_id,shop_name,order_id having count(distinct order_status)>1)

select order_status,count(*) as rows,count(distinct order_id) as distinct_order_ids
from tiktok group by 1 order by 2 desc
select currency,count(*) as rows from tiktok group by 1 order by 2 desc

select count(*) as rows, count(distinct order_sn) as distinct_order_ids,
 count(distinct (user_id, shop_name, order_sn)) as user_shop_order_keys,
 count(distinct pkId) as distinct_pk_ids, count(distinct shop_name) as shop_names,
 count(distinct user_id) as users,
 min(try_cast(create_time as timestamp)) as min_created,
 max(try_cast(create_time as timestamp)) as max_created,
 min(try_cast(synced_at as timestamp)) as min_sync,
 max(try_cast(synced_at as timestamp)) as max_sync,
 count(*) filter(where pkId is null) as null_pk,
 count(*) filter(where order_sn is null) as null_order,
 count(*) filter(where create_time is not null and try_cast(create_time as timestamp) is null) as invalid_created,
 count(*) filter(where synced_at is not null and try_cast(synced_at as timestamp) is null) as invalid_sync,
 count(*) filter(where quantity is null or try_cast(quantity as integer) is null) as invalid_or_null_quantity,
 count(*) filter(where try_cast(quantity as integer)<=0) as nonpositive_quantity,
 count(*) filter(where regexp_matches(order_sn, '(?i)e[+-][0-9]+')) as scientific_order_ids
from shopee

select count(*) as affected_key_groups, coalesce(sum(n),0) as affected_rows
from (select pkId,count(*) as n from shopee
      group by pkId having count(*)>1)

select count(*) as affected_key_groups, coalesce(sum(n),0) as affected_rows
from (select pkId,count(*) as n from shopee
      group by pkId having count(distinct order_sn)>1)

select count(*) as affected_key_groups, coalesce(sum(n),0) as affected_rows
from (select user_id,shop_name,pkId,count(*) as n from shopee
      group by user_id,shop_name,pkId having count(distinct order_sn)>1)

select count(*) as affected_key_groups, coalesce(sum(n),0) as affected_rows
from (select user_id,shop_name,order_sn,count(*) as n from shopee
      group by user_id,shop_name,order_sn having count(distinct create_time)>1)

select count(*) as affected_key_groups, coalesce(sum(n),0) as affected_rows
from (select user_id,shop_name,order_sn,count(*) as n from shopee
      group by user_id,shop_name,order_sn having count(distinct order_status)>1)

select order_status,count(*) as rows,count(distinct order_sn) as distinct_order_ids
from shopee group by 1 order by 2 desc
select currency,count(*) as rows from shopee group by 1 order by 2 desc
select is_primary_row,count(*) as rows from shopee group by 1 order by 2 desc
select count(distinct shop_id) as shop_ids,count(distinct (shop_id,order_sn)) as shop_order_keys from shopee

select count(*) as shared_literal_sku_values
from (select distinct seller_sku as sku from tiktok where seller_sku is not null) t
join (select distinct item_sku as sku from shopee where item_sku is not null) s using(sku)

select count(*) as fact_rows,sum(is_successful_revenue) as successful_flags,
sum(is_cancelled) as cancelled_flags,
count(*) filter(where order_status='COMPLETED') as completed_status_rows,
count(*) filter(where order_status='CANCELLED') as cancelled_status_rows
from main_intermediate.fct_orders
